resources.string: A second space opened with its own PIN from the same lock screen

Set up a second space with its own PIN. You open it from the same lock screen by entering its PIN instead of yours. Everywhere else, this phone looks and works as usual and doesn\'t show the protected space.\n\nYou\'ll also choose a duress PIN and password, which wipe the phone when entered at any prompt, and optionally a reboot PIN, which restarts the phone so everything is locked again.
Confirm the PIN you use to unlock this phone.
Choose a PIN for the protected space
Entering this PIN on the lock screen opens the protected space. Use 6 digits or more, different from your PIN.
Entering this PIN at any prompt wipes the phone. It must differ from the other PINs.
Wipes the phone when entered where a password is asked. Use at least 4 characters.
Optional. Entering this PIN restarts the phone, so that both spaces are locked until their PINs are entered again.
Couldn\'t set up the protected space: %1$s
Show a shield in the status bar while this space is open, so you can tell it from the main space
